definitions.explanation: The act of connecting or linking things together, such as cables, devices, or transportation lines.
Changing from one train/bus line to another; connecting service.

examples.japanese: インターネットに{接続|せつぞく}する。
この{駅|えき}で{地下鉄|ちかてつ}に{接続|せつぞく}できます。
examples.english: You can transfer to the subway at this station.

examples.japanese: {接続|せつぞく}が{不安定|ふあんてい}で{動画|どうが}が{止|と}まってしまう。
examples.english: The connection is unstable, so the video keeps stopping.

examples.japanese: ケーブルを{接続|せつぞく}してください。
{次|つぎ}の{電車|でんしゃ}への{接続|せつぞく}が{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: The connection to the next train is poor.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}から{市内|しない}へのバスの{接続|せつぞく}が{便利|べんり}になった。
examples.english: The bus connection from the airport to the city has become more convenient.

notes:
{接続|せつぞく} is commonly used for both technical connections (internet, devices) and transportation transfers.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {接続|せつぞく}{詞|し}: conjunction (grammar)
- {接続|せつぞく}{駅|えき}: connecting station, transfer station
- Wi-Fi{接続|せつぞく}: Wi-Fi connection
- USB{接続|せつぞく}: USB connection

TECHNICAL USES:
- インターネットに{接続|せつぞく}する: connect to the internet
- {機器|きき}を{接続|せつぞく}する: connect devices
- {接続|せつぞく}{状態|じょうたい}: connection status

TRANSPORTATION:
- {乗|の}り{換|か}え: transfer (more common in everyday speech)
- {接続|せつぞく}: connection (more formal, schedule-focused)
